svg.text: Every stage on the main line. Every threshold on the edge that enters a stage. Every spawn out to its sub-sequence, with its return. Every loop drawn where it actually lands.

L6 NOTE — the name stays: era closure produces a NEW era and the old era stays in use and referenceable (his 9.4). Meanings are fixed with notes, never renames (his C-8). L1–L9 validated on T-1…T-4 · L10 drawn on his word · L11 awaits T-5.
THE SIX INVARIANTS — they hold at every stage above
BARRIER LAW — the line cannot cross a node while a required return is unaccepted
NO IN-PLACE LOOP — a sequence never re-enters a stage it has left; a retry is a new sub-sequence
NO REOPEN — a closed sequence stays closed; S₁ references S₀
CLOSURE IS A SEQUENCE WORD — entities persist, cohere, degrade, terminate
ENCOUNTER IS CONDITIONAL — two sequences meeting is an event with a condition
NEVER MANUFACTURE A SOURCE — a gap stays a gap, and the gap goes to the human
